title: Pull operation
description:
Information about a queued, in progress or completed pull operation.
*Formally called `dataset`*

id.description: Unique identifier of the pull operation.

companyId.description: Unique identifier of the company associated to this pull operation.

connectionId.description: Unique identifier of the connection associated to this pull operation.

dataType.title: Data types
dataType.description: The data type you are requesting in a pull operation.

status.title: Dataset status
status.description: The current status of the dataset.

statusDescription.description: Additional information about the dataset status.

errorMessage.description: A message about a transient or persistent error returned by Codat or the source platform.

progress.description: An integer signifying the progress of the pull operation.

isCompleted.description: `True` if the pull operation is completed successfully. The `isCompleted` property is not queryable. To filter failed pull operations, query by `status!=Complete&&status!=NotSupported` instead.

isErrored.description: `True` if the pull operation entered an error state.
